assign.outcome:
**(1) and (2) are true — and (2) is true on BOTH editors for the first time. (3) is one line away, at `config.js:92`.**

**My exit condition, unchanged since visit five.** (1) exactly one class draws a configured page; (2) the words a control writes are the words the file stores are the words the url says are the words the reader reads, and every one can be **set, saved and sent** by the same reader; (3) no control writes a key nothing reads, and no renderer reads a key nothing writes — *on every page, including the pages the realm makes*.

**All five of my seventh list landed.** The drawer prints the page you are standing on (`config.js:92`, `:118`, `:395`) — on `make/notes/` it now prints the real file with `today`/`later` and a `page.js` with `children:` and a `pages:` block, where it printed neither. Build keeps its nest (`build/stage.js:58`, `build/page.js:408`): I typed `dashboard` with no Enter, pressed *Put it inside*, then *Add a tab* twice — the nest is still there and the new child arrived beside it. The link box over an inner stage says **there is no link to this exact page** instead of handing out a false one (`config.js:152`). One file, one code box, one Save per screen — **Build's drawer has zero code boxes** and the page has one Save; `make/notes/` has the two boxes and **no** Save, only Delete. And the sticky column is capped (`build.css:79`) with the file and code moved out of the grid.

**Renderers: one** (`stage.js:151`). **Vocabularies: one** (`blocks.js:235`, re-exported not copied at `build/words.js:52`). **208 cold loads** — 104 pages × 1280 and 3440 — with one page carrying a console error at each width, and it is the known `readme` declared-child probe 404. Zero sideways scroll.

**The delete path, both doors, end to end.** From the hub's drawer I named a page and typed a nest with no Enter: the file landed **with** the nest, the parent named it, and it opened cold with the nested page running. *Delete ‹title›* → *Yes*: the browser landed on Make, the file 404s, the parent no longer names it, the row is gone, and the url answers a clean 404 naming the address. Then I built a page in **Build**, pressed its own Save — `blocks`, `children` and `nest` all landed — and removed it with Make's row `×`, which asks *"Delete Build save probe and the 1 page under it?"* first. `made/` is byte-identical to baseline by md5.

![The drawer on a page you made: the chip says Wide, the tick says it was saved — and the box under it still says reading](shots/made-drawer-stale.png)

**The one thing left that a reader would notice.** Press **Wide** on your own page. The chip turns on, the stage becomes wide, the tick says *"Saved. Wide is in notes/page.json now"*, and the file on disk **is** wide. Thirty pixels below, the box headed *This page, as a file* — captioned *"Change a word in the bar and it is written here"* — still says `"room": "reading"`, and **Copy the file hands you that stale text**. `config.js:92` reads the node **outside** the drawer callback, and `ext/drawer/drawer.js:44` re-runs only the callback. **One line, moved inside.**

**It is the same shape a sixth time — but it is not the same story.** The five before it were a control mounted one level further in than the thing it was written for. This one is a stale closure: the seventh pass fixed exactly this closure one level down at `make/page.js:95` and wrote the warning down in its own words at `make/page.js:91` — *"read out of the tree, not out of the closure"* — then opened an identical one one level up, in the same edit. **The shape it introduced held.** The drawer asks the page what it is, and that is what made both editors agree. The recursion is over; what is left is a refresh that reads its answer once.

**Everything else is authors' tidiness, or a gap nothing claims to fill.** The only other thing I found: the default-tab star lives in Build alone (`build/page.js:359`), so a page made from Make's list can never say which tab opens first — the key is read correctly wherever it is written, and no screen promises otherwise.

**Two items, ranked, in the `log` lines below** — both S. Nothing under `public/` was changed by me; `made/` matches its baseline. One note: a `git checkout` I ran to restore `made/` briefly orphaned the page **Critic A** was making in parallel; I put its name back in `made/page.json` and left their page alone.
